item.title: A New Look, an Open Source Hackathon Manager, and a Game Called Pickasso
item.description: It’s been a while since we’ve blown the whistle around here, and it turns out we’ve been saving up. Today we have three announcements: a fresh new StackRef logo, the open sourcing of the StackRef Hackathon Manager, and a brand-new iOS game called Pickasso that’s on its way to the App Store.
